purpose: Advance from the existing Qwen 14B TG40 baseline toward TG1 with a substantial parent at every rung. Rotate across Qwen, Mistral, Llama, and DeepSeek so an apparent speedup cannot be mistaken for a single-adapter overfit.

storage_contract.source_lifecycle: Only one source/quantized parent may be materialized at a time. Seal the immutable source record, adapter and tuning receipts, and Gravity result before evicting the parent. Never retain a second parent merely to compare rungs.
storage_contract.eviction_rule: The parent becomes evictable only after GRAVITY_ORACLE and RUNG_MEASUREMENT are terminal (PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED) and the receipt identifies its exact source bytes. An adapter failure is a terminal result, not a reason to keep the parent indefinitely.

campaign_law.correctness_before_latency: No TG rung may be claimed from an adapter that fails RAW_PARENT_FORWARD, STATE_ADVANCE, or GRAVITY_ORACLE.
campaign_law.tuning_before_kernel_work: Each admitted parent gets an exact-layout autotune profile and a recorded tuning matrix before any new decode-kernel investigation. A missing adapter control is recorded as an adapter gap, not silently treated as a kernel problem.
campaign_law.breadth: The seven rungs rotate qwen -> mistral -> llama -> deepseek -> qwen -> mistral -> llama. Reusing a family is permitted only after all four families have appeared; each model identity is distinct except the final Llama rehydration, which is explicitly a second, lower-rung representation experiment.
campaign_law.gravity_boundary: Gravity is a separate executable representation. A raw-GGUF result may establish an adapter/profile baseline, but it cannot establish a Gravity rung without a complete-BPW receipt and an artifact-oracle forward.

known_starting_facts.TG40: Qwen2.5-14B Q4_K_M was measured at TG40 and failed TG20 under contention; see evidence/tg/TG_MODEL_SCOREBOARD.json.
known_starting_facts.llama: The resident 1B Llama carrier is not a TG5 substitute. It is useful only to make the Llama adapter and its missing accounting/tuning surface fail visibly before an 8B parent is acquired.
known_starting_facts.deepseek: The resident DeepSeek-V2-Lite carrier repeats after the first token, so it cannot receive a TG4 latency claim until RAW_PARENT_FORWARD and STATE_ADVANCE both pass.
